points.t: The Primary organization helps God’s children prepare to return to His presence.
Nursery helps children 18 months to 3 years feel Heavenly Father’s love and learn about His plan of happiness. At least two people should be called for each nursery class.

Primary classes are organized by age and the number of teachers available. Units with fewer children or teachers may combine two or more age-groups into one class. Children are divided into classes based on their age on December 31 of the previous year: Sunbeam (3), CTR 4–6, and Valiant 7–10.
It is a sacred privilege to teach children. When adults teach children in Church settings, at least two responsible adults should be present.
Valiant activity leaders minister to children as they plan service and activities beginning in January of the year children turn 8.
